title: 2023 AMC 12A Problem 2
statement: The weight of \(\tfrac13\) of a large pizza together with \(3\tfrac12\) cups of orange slices is the same as the weight of \(\tfrac34\) of a large pizza together with \(\tfrac12\) cup of orange slices. A cup of orange slices weighs \(\tfrac14\) of a pound. What is the weight, in pounds, of a large pizza?

solutions.text:
Let the pizza weigh \(P\) pounds. Then \(3\tfrac12\) cups weigh \(\tfrac72\cdot\tfrac14=\tfrac78\) and \(\tfrac12\) cup weighs \(\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac14=\tfrac18.\)

The equation is \[ \tfrac13 P+\tfrac78=\tfrac34 P+\tfrac18. \]

Subtracting gives \(\tfrac78-\tfrac18=\left(\tfrac34-\tfrac13\right)P,\) so \(\tfrac34=\tfrac{5}{12}P\) and \(P=\dfrac{9}{5}=1\tfrac45.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Let the pizza weigh \(P\) pounds; each cup of orange slices weighs \(\tfrac14\)
Set the two weights equal and gather the \(P\) terms on one side
